source.confirmation: Confirmed source and retained 36-group capture supplied for ticket 05.

notes: Prototype states are memory-only. No formal behavior/acceptance claims.
At390px prototype hides cards; card crop explicitly unavailable; formal mobile card requirements still apply per latest spec.
Latest spec overrides older prototype mobile dt/dd two-column styling with vertical label/value; omit prototype memory/debug content from product.
Expanded capture uses same input/state as its default pair; default capture closes expanded without altering content.
Prototype390px empty model basis has narrow-column vertical wrapping of 尚未采用素材; known target responsive defect, formal should use readable empty text per spec, not reproduce defect.
Prototype390px basic-image actions are horizontal and dt/dd pairs horizontal; latest spec explicitly requires stacked actions and vertical label/value, record this intentional correction.
Prototype text-model ready card uses centered icon plus generic summary; latest spec explicitly requires readable formal-text summary, not temporary/generic result.
Card body screenshots exclude external title; cardWithTitle supplements default/empty desktop and large viewport. Expanded card remains behind modal and dimmed intentionally.

Actual image inspection: all36 editor original-size screenshots; eight1440 default/empty cardbody screenshots; four1440 default card-title crops; four wholepage context samples across threeviewports. Additional stored wholepage/card crops are generated but not all independently viewed.
